PHASE.NAME: Full RTK Parity Matrix
PHASE.GOAL: Create a source-derived full RTK parity gate so Synapse can distinguish integration readiness from complete standalone RTK parity.

STEPS.step-1: Add --full parity mode that parses rtk-develop top-level commands, hook processors, and command-module files.
STEPS.step-2: Classify coverage as implemented, equivalent, superseded, or missing and expose text/JSON output.
STEPS.step-3: Keep existing --ci integration gate green while --full --ci fails on missing full-RTK coverage.
